results.name: overlay
notes: Actual virtual-desktop window; first half moves a 640x360 selection, second half moves a selection spanning 75% of each canvas dimension. Symmetric-difference strips, borders and labels are redrawn.
Timers include synchronous WM_PAINT and GdiFlush; exclude DWM presentation/vsync. Frozen desktop pixels are never written to disk.

Exactly three owned full-screen images coexist: immutable shared FrozenScreen, precomputed mask, and back buffer. Capture writes directly into the retained frozen DIB. Private commit is sampled after initialization and every 100 frames; observed peak is not the OS lifetime peak. Close releases all three before the final memory sample; a 5 MiB allowance covers window/allocator bookkeeping.
BeginPaint already clips the destination to the precise update region; rcPaint is only its bounding rectangle. Back-buffer composition separately clips each dirty strip.
